title: Studio HDRI (mixed natural light)
description: A 24K HDRI of a bright home-office studio. Soft natural light mixed with downlights, low contrast, giving 3D material in Three.js a natural reflection and shadow
when_to_use: When a 3D model, such as a product mockup, needs natural environment reflections and shadows instead of a flat background. Especially as background or environment light for a product intro or a UI explainer
ai_usage: 取得後に fragment 化する際は、環境光強度（exposure）と回転のみ変数化してよい。HDRI そのもの（撮影データ）は改変しない。低コントラストな光質を崩す強い色調補正は加えない
